messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: cont-batch p99 spike detected on prod-usw2. metric: serving.contbatch.latency.p99 > 1200ms for 3m, streaming stalls increasing. Potential KV cache pressure and pack-shed events. 

tim_oncall: seeing the spike on the dashboard, p95 up ~350ms, p99 ~1.3s. Streaming stall count up x4 in the last 5m. Any recent deploys? :eyes: 

maria_p: no deploys in last hour. I'm checking per-model tail stats now. Looks concentrated on model: gptx-13b-quant-8 and on routes: chat/stream. Mixed seqlen customers spike. 

kirin: adding tracelog for affected host pool (pool-id: contbatch-usw2-3). running: `rdwctl tracing enable --pool contbatch-usw2-3 --sample 10%` 

ashley: on logs I see many large-batch eviction warnings + KV miss storms. Likely pack-shed/backpressure from a few long seq requests padding out batches. 

maria_p: confirmed heavy seqlen tail from two customers (cust-A, cust-B). Their median len normal but tail > 8k tokens; continuous batch scheduler is packing and then hitting paging. 

tim_oncall: immediate mitigation options: 1) reduce max_batch_size for cont-batch path, 2) enable preemptive short-seq priority, 3) temporarily route streaming traffic to dedicated streamers. Thoughts? 

kirin: we can flip a config flag to lower batch target size: `rdwctl config set serving.contbatch.max_batch_tokens=4096 --env prod-usw2` — that will reduce per-batch memory and KV pressure. 

ashley: alternatively, enable seqlen-aware pack-shed: `serving.scheduler.enable_seqlen_hedging=true` but that is less tested. I'd prefer reducing max_batch first. 

tim_oncall: go for reducing max_batch_tokens to 4096 now. maria, kirin, ashley can you coordinate the flip + watch? I'll page SRE if it doesn't move. 

kirin: applying change now (rolling across pool): `rdwctl rollout config serving.contbatch.max_batch_tokens=4096 --pool contbatch-usw2-3` 

infra-bot: rollout started: rollout_id=rr-20260315-001, target_pools=contbatch-usw2-3, parallel=4, strategy=rolling. Monitor: https://console.redwood/infrastructure/rollouts/rr-20260315-001 

maria_p: change is in, watching tail. p95 trending down within 60s. p99 dropping from 1.3s -> 900ms so far. Streaming stalls reduced but still some residual. 

tim_oncall: good. Next: evict very long seq load from cont-batch by adding an escape route to dedicated-stream cluster for flagged customers cust-A and cust-B. Can product coordinate with network/routing? 

cust-success-jess: I can message cust-A and cust-B to let them know we may route traffic briefly for stability. Will coordinate with account owners. 

ashley: setting a routing rule: `rdwctl routing add --pool dedicated-streamers-usw2 --match customer in (cust-A,cust-B) --priority 100 --temp 1h` — applying. 

infra-bot: routing change applied: rule_id=rt-20260315-007, effective immediately. 

maria_p: after routing flagged customers off cont-batch, p99 now ~640ms and stalls near baseline. KV eviction events down by 78%. Looks stable. 

tim_oncall: ok that bought us breathing room. Need follow-ups: 1) postmortem to analyze why scheduler didn't preempt large sequences earlier, 2) consider default max_batch_tokens reduction for mixed-seqlen workloads, 3) create per-customer seqlen backpressure alerts. Will create tasks. 

kirin: filing ops ticket: `OPS-987` with initial notes + link to rollout and logs. Planning to run a replay test with synthetic long-tail sequences to tune packer heuristics. 

ashley: quick config experiment: for hetero loads we can enable 'short-first' scheduling to prioritize finishing small seqs in a pack. Example config: ```json
{
  "scheduler": {
    "policy": "short-first",
    "preemptive_cutoff_ms": 50,
    "max_batch_tokens": 4096
  }
}
``` 

tim_oncall: let's test short-first in canary tomorrow. For now, leave contbatch.max_batch_tokens=4096 and routing rule in place. 

cust-success-jess: I've notified the account owners. They appreciate the quick mitigation and prefer minimal routed time. I'll give them update in 30m. 

maria_p: creating a dashboard panel for 'contbatch seqlen tail per customer' and an alert: threshold p99_seqlen>6k across 5m. That should catch this earlier. 

kirin: scheduling handoff: @lee_night will take shift at 23:00 UTC. leaving runbook notes in thread and ops ticket. 

lee_night: I'll monitor overnight. If we see recurrence, immediate actions: 1) escalate to infra for further pool isolation, 2) toggle `serving.contbatch.enable=false` for that pool as last resort. Understand? 

tim_oncall: yep. mar ia/kirin/ashley — please add concrete rollback and escalation steps to OPS-987. I'll update incident with customer impact summary and timeboxed mitigation. 

ops-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: cont-batch tail latency mitigated. Reduced max_batch_tokens and temporarily rerouted 2 customers to dedicated streamers. Customer impact: degraded p99 for ~12m window, no customer-facing errors observed. Links: OPS-987, rollout rr-20260315-001, route rt-20260315-007. 

maria_p: adding a note: we need to review model variant quantization memory profiles — gptx-13b-quant-8 has tight KV mem headroom. Might be worth a memory-profiling pass. 

tim_oncall: agreed. Good job team. Handoff to @lee_night in 15m. I'll mark pager as acknowledged. :white_check_mark: 

lee_night: acked. I'll keep thread updated if any regressions occur.
